messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created by monitoring: elevated error-rate and latency for model-serving-prod v4.4. Root metric: token-error-rate up 5x and 95th p99 latency spike to 2.4s (baseline ~600ms).

maya: I got paged for this alert, joining. Seeing traffic skewed to eu-west1, errors look like malformed JSON from some responses + increased tail latency.

samir: I'm on logs. Error pattern = invalid response framing from runtime when kv cache miss + concurrent requests. Suspect a model runtime/quantization regression in v4.4.

jess: Product: any customer-facing impact? We should prepare a status page entry if customers in EU are affected.

liam: Support: ~12 customers reporting slowed responses, 3 reported incorrect/garbled completions in last 30m. I'll collect SIDs.

kevin: I'm pulling recent deploys. Deploy-bot, who pushed v4.4 and when?

deploy-bot: Deploy record: model-serving-prod:v4.4 deployed by @kevin at 2100123000 to eu-west1 and us-central1. Canary 15% in eu-west1. No automated rollbacks triggered.

maya: Good to know. Can we pin traffic back to v4.3 while we investigate? Need a safe mitigation plan.

kevin: Agree. I can initiate a soft rollback to v4.3 in eu-west1 for canary and then scale back. Command: ```rbctl rollout set model-serving-prod --version v4.3 --region eu-west1 --traffic 100```

samir: Before full traffic switch, we can set routing rule to divert only failing requests based on error class? But quick mitigation = pin. I'll validate error signature to ensure routing won't misroute healthy requests.

maya: Do it, but notify customers. jess/aria, can you draft a short status page + customer email? Keep it factual: impact, mitigation in progress, ETA next update in 30m.

aria: Drafting. Suggested public status: "We are investigating increased latency and degraded response quality for some requests in eu-west1. We are rolling back a recent model update and expect restoration within ~30-60 minutes. No data loss reported." Thoughts?

jess: Good. Add: affected workloads: generation/chat endpoints using model-serving-prod. Provide link to incident channel for customers with dedicated contacts.

liam: I'll reach out to the 3 customers with garbled completions with a personal note and offer temporary pin to older model if needed.

kevin: Rollback initiated now to v4.3 in eu-west1: ```rbctl rollout set model-serving-prod --version v4.3 --region eu-west1 --traffic 100 --reason "rollback for quality/latency regression"```

ops-bot: Rollout job started (job id: ROLLOUT-9532). Estimated time 4 minutes.

samir: I'm watching logs; error rates dropping on canary instances as soon as new route applied. p99 latency trending down.

maya: ops-bot please post status page update when the rollback completes. jess, aria: ready to post customer comms when I confirm restore.

ops-bot: Rollout job completed at 2100123605. Traffic now on v4.3 in eu-west1.

samir: Confirmed. token-error-rate back to baseline, p95/p99 restored. No new garbled completions in the last 90s.

maya: Great. I'll mark incident as mitigated and start RCA thread. But keep channel open for follow-ups.

jess: Status page update posted: "Incident mitigated: rollback to v4.3 restored normal service in eu-west1. We are investigating the root cause of quality regressions in v4.4; next update in 4 hours or sooner." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2100123456

aria: Customer email template sent to affected accounts with personalized SIDs. Template snippet used: "We observed degraded quality and elevated latency for model-serving-prod v4.4 in eu-west1. We rolled back to v4.3; your requests should be back to normal. We're investigating and will update you with findings."

liam: Customers acknowledged; two asked for logs for their requests — sent secure artifacts. One asked for an SLA credit assessment; flagged to finance.

kevin: For the RCA: initial suspicion is runtime change interacting with quantized attention kernels introduced in v4.4; I have a repro on a small trace. Will open a JIRA and attach trace + model diff.

samir: Next steps for oncall handoff: I'll document mitigations and pending actions. Leaving notes: 1) monitor for recurrence for 6 hours 2) run full regression eval corpus for v4.4 on small infra 3) hold v4.4 from further rollouts until root cause fixed 4) coordinate postmortem and customer-facing technical write-up.

maya: I'm handing off to samir for next 6-hour watch. Handoff note: rollback done, status page updated, customers contacted, JIRA TBD-4312 created for RCA, contact list pinned.

samir: Taking over. Oncall playbook items I've started: monitor dashboards, add alert for garbled_response metric, schedule deeper trace collection at low-traffic window.

kevin: One more safety: add a model-pin policy so customers can request enforced version pinning per org while we stabilize. Suggested config snippet for ops team: ```{"org_id": "<ORG>", "model": "model-serving-prod", "pinned_version": "v4.3", "expires_at": "2026-03-16T12:00:00Z"}``` We'll expose pin via API and console.

jess: Product note: Add admin UI banner to inform customers if their account is pinned/pinning requested. Liaise with support for pin lifecycles.

aria: Also preparing a short FAQ for customers: why rollback, what about data, when will v4.4 be safe.

liam: Filing internal customer ask tickets for those who requested pins/credits.

ops-bot: Incident status changed to "Mitigated" by maya at 2100123720. Incident will stay open for RCA.

maya: Thanks all. Samir, please post a short RCA draft in this channel when you have it. I'll take over communication for enterprise customers after RCA.

samir: Will do. Draft outline: timeline, impact, root cause (suspected), mitigation steps, long-term fixes, rollback/rollout policy updates. ETA 24h initial draft.

kevin: I'll include a minimal repro + test harness in the Jira. Also coordinate with eng-runtime to add additional unit/integration tests around the quantized kernel interface.

jess: Listing action owners: kevin -> root cause & tests; samir -> RCA & monitoring; aria -> customer comms; liam -> support follow-ups; maya -> incident signoff & executive summary.

maya: Handoff complete. Samir, you're the point for the next 6 hours. Leaving channel open. :white_check_mark:
